scope: Original-engine static main_menu model preview in independently written integration glue. Not the reconstructed client menu state.

instruction_anchors.meaning: I3DGetDriver returns the singleton
Driver initialize cleans self and flags
Driver close cleans self
Factory wrapper accepts stack self and frame kind
Kind 13 installs scene vtable
Kind 3 installs camera vtable
Kind 2 installs light vtable
Kind 5 installs sector vtable
Factory sets kind/refcount and invokes thiscall initializer before returning
Shared frame Release cleans self
Position setter cleans self and vector pointer
Direction setter cleans self, direction and optional up pointer
LinkTo cleans self, parent and flags; no fourth stack argument
Camera field-of-view setter cleans self and float
Camera range setter cleans self and two floats
Camera orthographic extent setter cleans self and float
Camera projection-mode setter cleans self and byte in stack word
Light type setter cleans self and kind
Light color setter cleans self and RGB pointer
Light intensity setter cleans self and float
Active-camera setter cleans self and camera; it holds a reference
Scene render forwards self and flags to driver+20 and preserves its status in EAX
Original menu camera x = 0.5
Original menu camera y = -0.375
Original menu camera z = -15.5
Original near/far range 0.2 and 20
Original menu enables orthographic projection
Original orthographic extent = 2
Original client reads primary sector at scene+1f8 and links its menu model

lifecycle: Initialize graphics before driver; driver factory initializes every allocated frame.
Configure the camera with the original position, direction and orthographic parameters.
Scene active-camera setter and AddFrame retain references; sector light membership is non-owning.
Model LinkTo changes hierarchy without retaining it; keep the model alive until after rendering.
Release model, local light and local camera references, then scene; close driver before graphics.

resources.texture_selection: Unique nonempty first-table name fields, plus the implicit scene-default snow texture.
resources.precedence: Extracted base Models/Maps slice only. No Patch, Maps_U or original archive-overlay behavior.

limitations: Static model preview only; original UI controls, fonts, localized text, cursor, sound, movies and screen transitions are not implemented.
One verified scene layout field (primary sector at +1f8) is read because no public accessor is known.
Scene rendering performs its own BeginScene/EndScene; host only presents afterward.
A desktop runtime test is still required; compile/evidence checks do not prove artwork visibility or clean shutdown.
New integration code adds no original-function reconstruction credit.
